idea.title: SignalScout — Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers

plan.tagline: Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers.
plan.problem: Indie hackers struggle to identify and capitalize on emerging trends in their niche quickly.
plan.solution: 1. Users input their niche keywords. 2. The tool scans predefined sources for trends. 3. It generates a report of current trends. 4. Users receive alerts for significant changes. 5. Data is stored locally for offline access.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses looking for actionable insights on market trends.
plan.demo_script: The --demo mode showcases hardcoded data for three niche keywords, displaying current trends, a sample report, and alert notifications without needing an internet connection.
plan.phuket_angle: Targeting local businesses in Phuket to identify tourism trends and optimize offerings.
